name: Roshutsu Shoujo Tora 2

An exhibitionist ADV novel game about Taiga from Toradora!

If you liked seeing her piss on the train and show off her sutopan crotch, then you'll love seeing her tied up, blindfolded and photographed on smartphones while she gets off on the shame!

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE093800.html]DLsite english[/url]]
